sid_questItemprototypes_E11_MQ04_PDA_Che: Chornozem’s PDA, found in a warehouse at the Chemical Plant. Apparently, there was more to the bandit than meets the eye.
sid_questItemprototypes_E11_MQ04_PDA_Nes: Nestor’s PDA, found in a warehouse at the Chemical Plant. The former Garbage kingpin apparently had the backing of someone even more important than the Ward.
sid_questItemprototypes_E11_MQ04_Protoco: At first glance, this file of documents found in the infirmary of the Chemical Plant appears totally unremarkable. However, the papers inside are clearly not meant for prying eyes.
sid_questItemprototypes_Zalesie_KoldunNo: A brief, succinct message written on a scrap of paper.
sid_questItemprototypes_Zalesie_HomakNot: A small handwritten note. The messy, uneven handwriting aptly capture the sender’s emotional state.
sid_questItemprototypes_Zalesie_NoteFrom: A stack of hastily scribbled sheets. Only one note is actually legible amid the otherwise indecipherable chicken-scratchings.
sid_questItemprototypes_Zalesie_LinzaPDA: An ordinary piece of paper with a message for a buddy on it. The use of different inks in various sections suggests that the author didn’t write it all in one go.
sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ20_Lost_PDA_: Yet another stalker who wanted to go back to the Mainland, but couldn’t. It’s difficult to find a way out when there’s nowhere to go. For folks like him, the Zone is a one-way ticket.
sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ21_MemoryDia: The note contains memories of what this place used to be like before the Disaster. The paper is visibly worn – it seems to have been carried by the wind over the bridge for quite some time.
sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ22_ClearSkyN: An old sheet of paper ripped from a diary containing a scientist’s notes from his expedition with Scar. “September 2011” is faintly discernible on the surviving portion of the page.
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_MQ03_4thKaym: Notes from Dr. Kaymanov found in his office at Lab X7.
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_MQ03_5thKaym: Notes from Dr. Kaymanov found in his office at Lab X7.
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_MQ03_6thKaym: Notes from Dr. Kaymanov found in his office at Lab X7.
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_MQ03_Instruc: An old instruction sheet covered with handwritten notes in red pencil.
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_MQ03_Caribbe: Old scientific papers outlining the experiment that confirmed the Noosphere theory. These records paved the way to the Zone’s emergence.
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_AgentsFile_A: Archive of Files on C-Consciousness Agents

The archive encompasses hundreds of files detailing every agent recruited by C-Consciousness. For years, these people operated in the Zone and beyond, unknowingly carrying out instructions they were programmed to execute. The list includes a number of familiar names.
sid_questItemprototypes_EQ08_FreshBread_: Soft and crispy, with the lingering smell of the oven. How on earth Myklukha gets fresh bread to the Zone is anyone’s guess, but it’s only available in Rostok.
sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ24_VenyaNote: A crumpled note discovered in a Prypiat apartment. The author wrote down his last words, and yet his handwriting is still surprisingly steady and neat.
sid_items_QuestArtifactHeartOfChornobyl_: An incredibly rare, almost mythical artifact that functions as a psi-radiation amplifier. The degree of amplification depends on the characteristics and individual capabilities of the source. Its properties are still not fully understood, with the comprehensive range of parameters yet unknown. Presumed to encapsulate the original structure of the Zone’s matter.
sid_questItemprototypes_Terricon_PDAAbou: If the message on this PDA is any indication, the owner has more pressing concerns than the prospect of losing the device.
sid_questItemprototypes_Terricon_NoteLis: Piece of Paper with a List
A tattered handwritten note revealing a concise plan devised by four comrades from the Slag Heap. What could have happened to them?
sid_questItemprototypes_Terricon_Hub_Mer: Abandoned without much thought by its owner, this PDA is covered in a surprisingly thick and even layer of dust. It seems like no one has picked it up for a very long time.
sid_questItemprototypes_Terricon_Hub_Kis: Found in the catacombs beneath the Slag Heap, this PDA serves as a reminder to think twice before crossing its former owner.
sid_questItemprototypes_Terricon_Hub_Zor: Despite being chipped around the edges, this PDA still remains operational – unlike its former owner.
sid_questItemprototypes_NoonBase_Hub_Pan: This misplaced PDA contains the Noontider’s correspondence, but it would be inappropriate to intrude into his private messages.
sid_questItemprototypes_NoonBase_Hub_Vec: An ordinary PDA containing correspondence on topics that concern everyone on Wild Island to varying degrees.
sid_questItemprototypes_E04_Note_UnityNo: A scrap of paper revealing the meticulously detailed thoughts and feelings of an unknown Noontider.
sid_questItemprototypes_NoonBase_Hub_Ros: A battered PDA belonging to a Noontider that contains an exchange filled with contemplations about the Mainland.
sid_questItemprototypes_E04_NoteDubnyjTo: A carefully folded sheet of paper containing handwritten text. The letters appear almost etched into its surface.
sid_questItemprototypes_NoonBase_Hub_Zav: Covered in small scratches and scuffs, this PDA seems to be ever-ready and functional, even when not intentionally in use.
sid_questItemprototypes_IKAR_PikmanPDA_d: A standard military-grade PDA. The device is somewhat hard to activate – the button requires a slightly longer and firmer press than usual.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_NoteKal: An ordinary 8x12 sheet outlining Kalina’s plans for the day. It’s packed with activities – there doesn’t seem to be a single moment of free time in her schedule.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_PDAKali: This device boasts abundant contacts, but very little correspondence. Its owner promptly deletes whatever she doesn’t want others to see.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_PDASult: Outgoing messages are a rare sight on this PDA, and incoming messages are even rarer.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_PDASych: This PDA has been through a lot, much like its owner. Only recent correspondence is still there – the rest has been deleted.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_NoteKal: This sheet serves as Sonya Kalina’s appointment book. Her time is precious indeed – anyone who canceled a meeting with her would have a lot of explaining to do.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_NoteAgr: This document has been carefully preserved against dirt and damage. The Sultan turns to it for a quick pick-me-up whenever he’s feeling blue.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_NotePar: The scuffs on this sheet of paper indicate that it was passed around, and the ink stains confirm that the grocery list must have been a group effort.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_PDARyhl: This PDA is in quite a battered state, yet its owner fared far worse.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_NoteZlo: A small scrap of paper covered in scrawled handwriting. The author was clearly in a hurry.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_PDAChil: This PDA is in good shape, indicating that its owner steers clear of situations that could result in damage to the device.
sid_questItemprototypes_Sultansk_NoteKal: The uneven handwriting on the paper betrays the author’s nervous state. On the other hand, the notation at the bottom looks like it was written in a steady, confident hand.
A sheet of neatly laid-out text, leaving plenty of free space to accommodate the author’s ambitious plans.
sid_questItemprototypes_Shevchenko_NoteD: A intact page from a stalker’s diary, found on the Shevchenko. It offers a glimpse into the author’s life over the course of several days.
sid_questItemprototypes_Shevchenko_NoteB: List of Equipment for the Shevchenko
A brief shopping list. Based on the items on it, someone either caused trouble for Beard, or he was getting ready to stir up some trouble himself.
sid_questItemprototypes_Shevchenko_Camp_: Sporting numerous well-worn stickers on the back panel, this aged PDA apparently sees little downtime.
sid_questItemprototypes_Malahit_PDADoroj: A PDA belonging to the Malachite trader. Its pristine condition is a testament to the owner’s perfectionism.
sid_questItemprototypes_Malahit_Hub_Note: Written Reply to a Request for Collaboration
A crumpled printout found at Malachite. Its contents clearly caused great offense to the recipient.
sid_questItemprototypes_Malahit_PDAKupri: This brand-new PDA contains negotiations between an STC Malachite employee and a stalker. Obtaining coupons from scientists is clearly no easy feat for a loner.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_NoteOrder_: A sheet of paper in impeccable condition, carefully preserved for a special occasion.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_KostaBandu: A typical PDA, showing signs of use and containing plenty of contacts and messages. Unless the owner has left for Prypiat, there’s a chance he might come back for it.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_NoteHana_d: A small sheet of paper that has been hastily filled out. Apparently, the author is no stranger to compiling such lists.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_SenaDymPDA: This PDA continues to receive messages, but there’s no one left to read them.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_Note_ToDoL: A crumpled sheet of paper full of corrections, annotations, and crossed-out sections.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_PDA_Garpia: Despite having seen its share of repairs, this PDA is in excellent working condition. Its owner clearly has a knack for technology and is in no rush to retire the device.
sid_questItemprototypes_Yanov_PDA_Nor_de: While there’s no apparent damage, the back panel of this PDA bears significant scuff marks, hinting that its owner tends to tap it on the table when nervous.
sid_questItemprototypes_Himzavod_Hub_Not: A report on a sheet of 8x12 paper. Given the illegible handwriting, its author was likely a medic.
A sheet of handwritten text. Even the letters themselves seem to stand at attention.
sid_questItemprototypes_RookieVillage_Wo: The screen of this dusty PDA is covered in a spiderweb of cracks. If Wolf ever uses it, it’s only as a backup.
sid_questItemprototypes_RookieVillage_Ma: A brand-new PDA. The owner’s whereabouts are unknown.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_NoteToShe: An ordinary sheet of paper with a list of goods on it. Each entry is meticulously written, indicating that the author thoroughly evaluated every item before adding it to the list.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_NoteToSul: A sheet with a list written in tidy handwriting. Deliberate and unhurried, the author gave careful consideration to every entry.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_NoteAgree: One of Myklukha’s many contracts that just happened to be out in the open. Normally, he keeps them hidden from prying eyes.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_YarikChil: Left unattended, this PDA contains a discussion about a guide known for never staying in one place.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_PDAPolovi: This PDA contains the correspondence that set in motion the events that ultimately led to the sergeant’s death.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_PDA_Lost_: Trying to juggle numerous tasks at once, this device’s owner occasionally forgets about certain things. In this case, he left his PDA behind without even noticing.
sid_questItemprototypes_Rostok_PDA_Docto: There isn’t a scratch or a speck to be found on this PDA. The owner meticulously wipes the device with alcohol on a daily basis.
sid_questItemprototypes_Prypat_NoteItem1: An 8x12 sheet carrying a message from someone who knows Degtyarev well.
sid_questItemprototypes_Prypat_NoteItem2: A short note penned in confident handwriting.
sid_questItemprototypes_RSQ07_C09_Contai: The gaps in the container are securely insulated, but it’s still giving off a little radiation. There must be an artifact in there.
sid_questItemprototypes_E11_MQ01_Cartrid: A small storage drive containing data from the signature station. It can only be read on a compatible device.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_ListWar: A note from Dvupalov’s desk at X5.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_ConrolR: A key to the control room of Lab X5’s experimental area.
sid_questItemprototypes_E11_MQ01_Stalker: PDA of a Stalker from X3
This PDA’s deceased owner found the new Oasis after all. However, as is often the case in the Zone, it wasn’t what it seemed. Unfortunately, a malfunction has rendered the stalker’s name illegible.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_SherbaT: A draft of a message addressed to Prof. Dvupalov, composed by a graduate student named Shcherba. It looks like someone is completely unable to let go.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_SciArti: It’s hard to fathom which scientific journal would have accepted this kind of research for publication.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_LetterF: Classified documents found in Lab X5. The laboratory apparently continued to operate under the direction of MOST after it was officially closed.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_Collars: This faded paper provides evidence of mutant experiments at Lab X5. The “Project Leash” label is barely legible.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_Dvupalo: A worn-out leather-bound notebook. Someone frequently consulted these notes, even after the professor had left the lab.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_Recepti: A note from Lab X5, stained with dried blood. It’s unclear whether the recipient managed to carry out the instructions.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_Strelok: Strelok’s old PDA. He went to his stash before making the decision to leave the Zone. Judging from the recording, the stalker had dealt a substantial blow to the Ward and intended to come back and finish the job.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ03_Dvupalo: One of the recordings is set on repeat. It's labeled “Prof. Dvupalov, 2006.”
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_DvupolovReco: The professor’s pocket voice recorder, containing Dvupalov’s sessions with his test subject. The device was left abandoned in the cell – more of a cage, really.
sid_questItemprototypes_ProjectControlle: These faded papers contain gruesome details about experiments conducted in X5. It looks like these are the documents Shcherba was after.
sid_questItemprototypes_E12_MO01_PDAOzer: A surprisingly neat PDA in almost pristine condition that somehow found its way into Spirit’s belongings. It only contains a single exchange with a colleague.
sid_questItemprototypes_E12_MO01_GroupsN: List of People Crossing the Boundary
A sheet containing an annotated list of names, found in Spirit’s bunker. There were probably many others like it, but only this sheet has survived.
sid_questItemprototypes_E12_MQ01_SkanerM: A modified scanner capable of temporarily disabling anomalies. It can be operated by anyone who has read the manual.
sid_questItemprototypes_E12_MO01_DuhToRi: A short message on a crumpled piece of paper.
sid_questItemprototypes_E08_MQ04_Undergr: A small key card granting access to one of the engineering rooms in the underground section of the Duga.
sid_questItemprototypes_E15_MQ03_Cartrid: A small storage drive. It can only be read on a compatible device.
sid_questItemprototypes_E11_MQ03_PTSthre: A yellowed and dusty report from the Troposphere Comm Station, filled out in neat handwriting. The author, whoever they were, took great care in their work.
sid_questItemprototypes_E07_SQ01_NoteFor: A note on a scrap of paper, left by a grateful rookie on Uncle Lyonya’s desk. Little did the rookie know that the former Zalissya guide would turn out to be a Monolithian…
sid_questItemprototypes_E16_MQ02_Marshal: A PDA belonging to a long-dead member of the original Spark. C-Consciousness used its owner’s memories as the basis for a new identity.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC00_PreOrder_F: A flash drive with a new message from the Journalist.
Another secret message from the Journalist.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ88_NimbleToBea: Looks like Beard gave Nimble an errand to run - ask around where some fellow named Sledgehammer went. The result isn't promising - Sledgehammer took off to Chornobyl and won't be getting Beard any more artifacts.
sid_questItemprototypes_ZuzaPDA_descript: The PDA of Gonta's apprentice, who dreamt of glory. It seems Yaryk had his reasons to chase a vibrant life, no matter how little of it he had left."
sid_questItemprototypes_nvgpack_supack_B: A regular door key with a tag
A regular key with something strange written on the tag: "d33s41d3m".
A scribbled draft that never got sent.
sid_questItemprototypes_nvgpack_supack_A: Personal file of a researcher from the dead group investigating a strange transmission
Just a regular plastic drive, with the letter M and a date scratched on the side. Contains a recording. I wonder what all this means.
sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ96_C01_: A worn-out set of technician's tools, specifically for radio electronics. They won't be much help for weapons or body armor repairs, but will definitely be useful for radio equipment.
sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ96_C03_: A professional set of tools. They'd make any technician happy, even on the Mainland. Allows any technician skilled enough to equip any kind of modification available in the Zone.
sid_questItemprototypes_supack_an_upm_se: A receiving signal antenna amplifier, military-grade. Old, but still operational.
sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ97_Gene: Fuel voucher for a generator at Kazkovyi. Looks like the group of campers before us left it.
sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ97_Pele: A laminated memo on an STC Malachite slip. Judging by its state, it's been passed on from the first NK group to each one after.
sid_questItemprototypes_d1paritypack_ANC: Security service log
A heavy leather-cover book with neatly drawn lines on its pages.
Complaint and request log
A heavy log with neatly drawn columns and dozens of different types of handwriting.
Observations notebook
A paperback notebook with snipers' notes.
Notes about MIA Duty fighters
A sheet of paper with notes about missing people. It looks messy, as every page has different handwriting and ink color.
Lone stalker's PDA
A device with a large crack in the screen and scratches on the back. The owner is not particularly careful with his equipment, or dedicated to his work.
Lone stalker's PDA
The PDA looks new, or the owner was very careful with it. There's nothing on it apart from work-related chats and a map.
Lone stalker's PDA
A PDA that has seen some skillful and not so skillful fixes. Looks like its owner had been through a lot before he ended up near the Duga.
Arena log
An old and worn-out paperback log, with notes written in Arnie's handwriting.
Folded note
A small sheet of paper with handwritten text.
Page from a log
An A4 sheet with handwritten notes. Neat, large letters look almost pressed into the paper, indicating Strider's handwriting.
Sonya Kalyna's notebook
Names, amounts, and short notes made with rushed but clear handwriting.
Target list
A perfectly folded sheet of paper with a list of names, written carefully in block letters.
Diary
A log with old and yellowed pages. Some of them still have readable text left.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_CircuitBoa: A complex board from an unknown device. A stalker would have no use for it, but it could be worth a lot.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_BrokenDash: Looks okay to be put up for sale, but only a merchant can tell whether it still works, or if I can only sell it for scrap.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_Oscillosco: A Japanese wideband oscilloscope. Used to be a top-shelf model 30 years ago, but still sells well. "P.D. Stryzh" is written on the inventory tag.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_Voltpannel: This model is popular, and pretty expensive. A perfect match for sensitive equipment.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_Voltmeter_: A precise voltmeter – a great tool for any technician. This one looks operational, and could be worth quite a lot of coupons.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_Powerbank_: An ancient model, as reliable and simple as they come. Any merchant would want it.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_OldMonitor: The CRTs from these sell pretty well. There are plenty of rumors about what they're used for, but no merchant will let you in on the secret.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_DashboardP: These haven't been around for about 40 years, but the scientists keep paying merchants to replace their worn-out ones.
sid_questItemprototypes_StalkerPDA_SQ103: A zombified stalker's PDA from the X18 laboratory. It's all covered in numbered gum wrappers. Missing just a few to complete the collection.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_Emitter_de: The Emitter that Diode needed so desperately. An open case with thin-film PCBs inside. A device like this can't be manufactured or repaired anywhere in the Zone.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ103_DeaddropIn: A notebook page with instructions, written in the same handwriting as the markings on the map.
sid_items_GunPM_HG_description: Service pistol, upgraded. Designed in the ’60s to equip police and army officers in Eastern Bloc countries. Popular in the Zone thanks to its reliability.
sid_items_GunUDP_HG_description: A pistol known for its ergonomic design, accuracy, and reliability. Widely favored in the Zone, it is sought after by both professionals and affluent newcomers.
sid_items_GunAPB_HG_description: A silenced pistol, once a staple of the Soviet Special Forces. In the Zone, it quickly became a tool of choice for discreetly resolving all manner of problems.
sid_items_GunM10_HG_description: Low price and low precision – that’s all you need to know about this submachine gun. Especially popular among rookies, but not for long. Real Zone life soon shows just how risky it is to cheap out on gear.
sid_items_GunRhino_HG_description: With its high caliber, this revolver is often marketed as a hunting weapon, proving equally effective against African buffalo and Zone chimeras.
sid_items_myriflepack_GunKora_HG_descrip: Pistol with a capital “P”. A true classic of firearm engineering. Designed over a century ago, yet still relevant today thanks to its powerful ammunition and near-total reliability under any conditions.
sid_items_GunViper_PP_description: A highly accurate and compact submachine gun favored by the rapid response units of various countries, as well as nearly every faction in the Zone.
sid_items_GunAKU_PP_description: A shortened variant of the renowned assault rifle, this weapon combines the firepower of its larger counterpart with the compact frame of a submachine gun. It proves particularly valuable when venturing deep inside the Zone.
sid_items_GunBucket_PP_description: Conceived by the USSR as a compact automatic self-defense weapon, this design has found popularity on the outskirts of the Zone despite its modest efficiency.
sid_items_GunIntegral_PP_description: An elite submachine gun renowned for its effectiveness in confined spaces. A favorite among seasoned diggers.
sid_items_GunZubr_PP_description: Based on the AKM-74U, the design of this submachine gun strikes a perfect balance between price, weight, accuracy, and rate of fire.
sid_items_nwpack_GunFora230_PP_descripti: Modern Ukraine-produced submachine gun, developed for combat vehicle crews and police special ops units. Thanks to its size and rate of fire, it found its niche in the Zone as well.
sid_items_GunAK74_ST_description: A modernized version of the iconic assault rifle. Exceptionally reliable in harsh conditions, it has become the weapon of choice for many factions in the Zone.
sid_items_GunAK74_Strelok_ST_description: A modernized version of the iconic assault rifle. Exceptionally reliable in harsh conditions, it has become the weapon of choice for many factions in the Zone.
sid_items_GunM16_ST_description: This assault rifle stands out as one of the most popular choices on the market. In the Zone, its true potential came to light during Freedom’s defense of the Barrier.
sid_items_GunG37_ST_description: This German-made assault rifle is an exemplary piece of modern weaponry, featuring lightweight construction, excellent reliability, and an ergonomic design.
sid_items_GunFora_ST_description: This modular next-gen assault rifle has earned multiple prestigious global accolades, along with unofficial commendations from the stalker community.
sid_items_GunGrim_ST_description: Automatic rifle and grenade launcher system – an assault rifle configuration that can come in quite handy in the Zone. A good fit for lovers of ultimate firepower at both short and medium distances.
sid_items_GunGvintar_ST_description: This specialized rifle designed for suppressed fire is highly regarded among veterans for its ability to keep the shooter’s position concealed.
sid_items_GunKharod_ST_description: A rare, advanced assault weapon system treasured by stalkers for its remarkable efficiency even in the most challenging conditions.
sid_items_GunLavina_ST_description: Derived from the Vintar sniper rifle, this silenced assault rifle enables effective firing without exposing the shooter’s position.
sid_items_GunDnipro_ST_description: Designed to replace the Soviet AKM-74 in special force units, this Ukrainian assault rifle is utilized not just by military special forces, but also by seasoned stalkers.
sid_items_nwpack_GunArev_ST_description: A game-changer in the world of guns. A modern assault rifle developed to potentially replace all platforms with intermediate and rifle calibers. Precise, reliable, comfortable. The only disadvantage is the price.
sid_items_GunPKP_MG_description: Combining the formidable firepower of a heavy machine gun with the portability of an assault rifle, this weapon excels at eliminating entire groups of enemies.
sid_items_GunObrez_SG_description: This small and lightweight sawed-off hunting shotgun proved itself surprisingly useful in the ever-changing environment of the Zone. Very efficient in close quarters and comfortable for concealed carry.
sid_items_GunTOZ_SG_description: A common hunting rifle, widespread and cheap. Still beats a handgun when it comes to dealing with mutants.
sid_items_GunM860_SG_description: A pump-action shotgun prized for its lightweight build and reliability, it has earned a distinguished reputation as one of the world’s most famous shotguns and remains extremely popular in the Zone.
sid_items_GunSPSA_SG_description: A distinctive shotgun designed to accommodate various rounds, including police ammunition. Although weighty, it boasts excellent firepower.
sid_items_GunD12_SG_description: Based on the AKM-74, this shotgun is favored among stalkers and professional military alike for its prowess as a powerful assault weapon.
sid_items_GunRam2_SG_description: Combining the strengths of pump-action shotguns and double-barreled rifles, this highly unusual weapon is an anomaly even by the Zone’s standards.
sid_items_nwpack_GunSKP_SP_description: The trend of regular infantry returning to the rifle carbine has finally reached the infantry carbine that was developed way back in World War II. A heavy-duty round and a modern stock allow this platform to be recognized as the same class as modern systems.
sid_items_GunMark_SP_description: An American-made semi-automatic rifle introduced in the early 1950s, it has undergone several modernizations and upgrades over the years.
sid_items_nwpack_GunGP3A_DMR_description: Classic German Cold War era rifle. Thanks to its overall ergonomics, decent reliability, and sturdy ammunition, this weapon system is still widely used.
sid_items_GunSVDM_SP_description: This tried-and-true sniper rifle is a common sight in the Zone, delivering solid performance at a reasonable price.
sid_items_GunM701_SP_description: Bolt-action sniper rifle. Considered a sport weapon on the Mainland, yet rather popular among mutant hunters and stalkers headed for Prypiat.
sid_items_GunSVU_SP_description: Sniper rifle designed for special forces. Some of the Zone’s wonders are better to watch from a safe distance. This beauty will help you to do just that.
sid_items_myriflepack_GunThreeLine_SP_de: This venerable three-line rifle spans both world wars and numerous other military conflicts. Legend has it its bullets can cut through rails — lengthwise.
sid_items_GunGauss_SP_description: Developed in the Zone and incorporating an electromagnetic bullet acceleration system, this sniper rifle is used exclusively within the Zone.
sid_items_GunRpg7_GL_description: A rocket-propelled grenade launcher dating back to the 1960s, found in abundance in military warehouses and subsequently making its way to the Zone. It operates as a smooth-bore, single-shot recoilless launcher.
sid_items_supack_Gun_GP37V2_AR_descripti: A rare modification of the GP37, designed for the German Navy. Its key distinction from the base version is the replacement of its automatic fire with a three-round burst mode. It was released in a limited run and failed to find favor.
sid_items_nwpack_GunArevPrecise_AR_GS_de: ARev version with modifications to enhance marksmanship capabilities. An 8x sight, heavy stock for comfortable bracing, reinforced barrel with 1:8 twist for better stability, and a silencer – the perfect setup for a precision shooter.
sid_items_myriflepack_Gun_NightStalker_H: A unique variant of the classic pistol. Custom-made components appear to have been precisely fitted during assembly. Chambered in 9mm Parabellum.
sid_items_Gun_ProjectY_HG_description: “All the Zone really needs is our compassion.”
sid_items_Gun_Star_HG_description: Developed in the 1960s, this modernized service pistol was introduced as the standard issue handgun for law enforcement and army officers in Eastern Bloc countries.
sid_items_Gun_GStreet_HG_description: Modeled after gangster movies from the 80s and 90s, this customized M10 may look impressive, but its practicality in the Zone remains questionable.
sid_items_Gun_RatKiller_SMG_description: A Zubr variant chambered for a different caliber. The body of this submachine gun boasts an urban camouflage paint job. It’s an absolute delight for shooting rats and rodents.
sid_items_Gun_Spitfire_SMG_description: A compact self-defense weapon combining the rate of fire of a machine gun with the accuracy typically found in assault rifles.
sid_items_Gun_Combatant_AR_description: “Dmytro and I were just discussing a certain puzzle we’ve been working on in the Zone, but we can’t quite seem to get all the pieces to fit. Give me a hand, would you?”
sid_items_Gun_Drowned_AR_description: Somebody dropped this assault rifle in water. It can still do a decent job if you treat it right.
sid_items_Gun_Lummox_AR_description: An old AKM-74S, must have fired thousands of rounds. Worn-out, but perfectly clean and greased. Looks like Valik Lummox never got the chance to see it in action.
sid_items_Gun_Decider_AR_description: An early version of the Fora-221, second-hand. The previous owner clearly splurged on upgrades.
sid_items_Gun_Sotnyk_AR_description: Degtyarev’s personal assault rifle is truly a universal soldier among weapons, equally effective against the most ferocious mutants and the most experienced enemy combatants.
sid_items_Gun_Sharpshooter_AR_descriptio: An experiment to convert an assault rifle into sort of a sniper carbine — surprisingly successful despite the limitations of its ammunition.
sid_items_Gun_Unknown_AR_description: An AR416 assault rifle found in the Poppy Field. It appears that the previous owner took excellent care of his weapon and seldom parted with it.
sid_items_Gun_Trophy_AR_description: An ordinary stalker acquired this special assault rifle in a battle with a certain veteran mercenary. It seems all that experience couldn’t spare the merc from an early grave.
sid_items_Gun_SOFMOD_AR_description: A rifle assembled by a certain Freedom member to suit his needs. An excellent choice if you want a single gun for tackling all the challenges the Zone throws your way.
sid_items_Gun_S15_AR_description: A factory-made Grom chambered in 5.45x39 caliber. While it may not have made waves on the Mainland for a number of reasons, in the Zone, it's acquired a devoted following, largely due to the wide range caliber it can accommodate.
sid_items_Gun_Sledgehammer_SG_descriptio: A custom modification of an Italian shotgun, made for a famous stalker. This firearm combines high damage with a surprisingly decent rate of fire for a shotgun.
sid_items_Gun_Texas_SG_description: A true embodiment of Texan gun culture, this weapon is heavy, expensive, powerful, and absolutely merciless.
sid_items_Gun_Tank_MG_description: A fusion of light machine gun and tank machine gun, this hybrid features a larger ammo box, a heavy barrel, and a lightweight bolt. The cost of improved reliability, extended range, and increased rate of fire is the substantial uptick in overall weight.
sid_items_Gun_Partner_SR_description: This well-worn Mark rifle is fitted with a collimator sight, indicating the owner’s desire to gain an edge in firefights at short and medium range.
sid_items_Gun_Whip_SR_description: This rifle has replaced the Lynx in the hands of the finest Monolith sniper. It’s rare to find a rifle that excels in both rate of fire and accuracy, but this one defies the norm.
sid_items_Gun_Cavalier_SR_description: The owner must have watched too many documentaries on early 20th-century military conflicts, leading to a desire to own a modern reinterpretation of a bolt-action cavalry carbine.
sid_items_Gun_SkifGun_HG_description: Skif’s honorary PTM. A somewhat painful reminder of the army that became a comfortable, familiar weapon.
sid_items_GunGauss_Scar_SP_description: A unique modification of the gauss cannon. It was designed specifically to disable electrical appliances, but it can also harm living creatures by affecting the target's nervous system.
sid_items_HeavyAnomaly_SIRCA_Armor_descr: One of the new-generation scientist suit versions. Ensures top-level protection from all known types of anomalous impact. Developed exclusively for SIRCAA.
sid_items_SEVA_Monolith_Armor_descriptio: «Why did you abandon us? We can’t hear you. We’re waiting for your orders.»
sid_items_UltraLight_Mercenaries_Armor_d: A suit upgraded for the Rostok bar bouncers. High-molecular polyethylene plates reduce weight, along with bullet resistance.
sid_items_Gun_ShotgunMonolith_SG_descrip: ... Blessed be their eternal union with the Monolith! Death, cruel death to those who reject Its sacred power!
sid_items_Gun_RifleMonolith_AR_descripti: ... To battle, defenders of the Monolith! Fight! Avenge our fallen brothers...
sid_items_Gun_PistolMonolith_HG_descript: Thank you for revealing the cunning plans of Your enemies to us! May Your light shine down on the souls of the brave soldiers who gave their lives in service to Your will. Blessed be their eternal union with the Monolith!
sid_items_Gun_Logarithm_SMG_description: An Integral-A after some serious tuning. The main difference from the basic version is a specialized barrel with an integrated sound moderator and a longer handguard.
sid_items_Gun_Zvirolov_SR_description: A rifle, modified specifically for better camouflage. Great for counter-sniping, especially in a forest.
sid_items_Gun_Gabion_AR_description: A short-barrel prototype of a special-ops rifle. Developed for concealed carry and extremely close-quarter battle.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC00_Deluxe_Fla: Flash drive with the Journalist's last message.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC00_Journalist: It looks like a regular PDA. But this one keeps the secret of the man who found what he was looking for in the Zone, and left on his own terms.
sid_items_Zorya_Tourist_Armor_descriptio: The former owner of this suit had an excellent understanding of weight distribution and echeloning of equipment. Redesigned pockets, a corset that relieves the back, additional pouches and a travel backpack allow you to carry more weight, which is very handy during long raids into the Zone.
sid_items_Gun_Veteran_AR_description: I'll make it, whatever it takes. I'll buy my own house... near the river, at the forest edge. No more radiation, no more beasts, no more freaking bastards.
sid_items_HeavyExoskeleton_Varta_Armor_d: A specialized Ward armored suit version. Equipped with a heavy-duty vest, built-in exoskeleton, a sturdy helmet and bright elements for fast identification friend or foe.
sid_items_Gun_ModelSpecial_HG_descriptio: A manual-assembly sport revolver. All the gaps adjusted, trigger mechanism replaced with a sharper one. Great choice for shooting bloodsuckers…speed shooting bloodsuckers.
sid_items_Gun_SMGMonolith_SMG_descriptio: "For it is your will, Monolith, that makes us strong. You have guided us. You have let us see and know. Why have you gone silent?.."
sid_items_Gun_Novator_AR_description: A Fora-221, with numerous modifications to achieve increased efficiency for special missions inside and outside the Zone. Equipped with a built-in sound moderator.
sid_items_Gun_Margach_SG_description: A customized version of the D-12 smooth-bore shotgun. Aluminum and polymer components reduce weight, improving the overall ergonomics.
sid_items_DLC01_AArtifactCNPPShard_descr: An artifact from the Flare that vaguely resembles a dainty wristwatch. Equipping it will halve psi impact, and phantoms will no longer have human faces.
sid_items_DLC01_AArtifactCNPP_MainFinal_: Gathered from flickers and time, the light of the Flare lowers psi impact. It also destroys phantoms in human form, and keeps away others, decreasing the level of their aggression towards the owner of the artifact.
sid_items_DLC01_AArtifactCNPP_SmallShard: A metallic artifact fragment from the Flare that produces a dim light from the inside. Using it with your gear will reduce headaches from psi, and keep your thoughts clear.
A metallic artifact fragment from the Flare that produces a dim light from the inside. Using it with your gear will reduce headaches from psi, and keep your thoughts clear.

sid_items_DLC01_Artifact_WaterDrip_descr: The water inside this artifact acts like it's in zero-gravity. When you carry it, you feel slightly lighter. The drops have a slight mercury-like gleam, but if you place the artifact in real mercury, the metal bounces off without even touching it.
sid_items_DLC01_ArtifactHeartofChimera_d: The heart of the chimera that managed to stay alive where it seemed impossible. Holding it, you can't shake the strange feeling—as if you have lived this very moment dozens of times, but never managed to remember how it ended.
sid_items_DLC01_MonolithMRE_description: This ration was designed for Monolith squad members. Despite its poor taste, the nutritional value and macronutrient balance are remarkably high.
sid_items_DLC01_Svarog_description: A late-stage prototype of a new-generation detector. Its modern component base improves the detector's characteristics, especially when detecting anomalous formations. Some of these developments were simplified and integrated into the serial Veles.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ02_DeadF: This old PDA belonged to a digger. Hidden within a lot of useless data are coordinates to the Iron Forest tunnel and messages to a friend who goes by Chatterbox.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_KoloP: A reddish-brown crust of dried blood covers the whole PDA. Its owner died a long time ago, but the device still has some life left in it.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Liman: The sheet of paper is clumsily folded, ripped, and looks like part of the map is missing. There are several marks, but one has been heavily circled with a red marker – the owners were looking for a way into the Radiowave Institute.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Buncu: Personal notes describing a Duty squad's failed attempts to reach the Radiowave Institute. The author writes that the city constantly changes itself, blocking the way through.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Cepur: A personal gadget of a Duty soldier. On the recording, Major Chepurnyi recounts how Tachenko shot Kosmach for attempting to switch off a certain device. The confession was lost in the "Miscellaneous" folder, right between photographs of his daughter and old local maps.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Famil: The photograph shows a happy boy with his parents. There's something wrong about the way they look, but it's hard to put a finger on what it is.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Bunch: A scrap of paper with a death note
A short confession. The author blames himself for Kosmach's death and can't live with that.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Chekh: The last recording is a monologue of an idealist who wanted to liberate the Zone, and then the whole world.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Bunch: Belonged to Bunchuk, a member of Tachenko's group. A standard model, but feels heavier than it looks. Makes you slightly nauseous.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Kosma: Belonged to Colonel Kosmach from Tachenko's group. The screen shows the only entry. No matter what you do, it's frozen, and won't close the entry or display the archive.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Tache: Belonged to General Tachenko. Even when turned off, it makes quiet white noise. You can sometimes hear indistinct sentence fragments.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Cepur: The device took some serious damage in a short, but fierce fight. Despite that, the recorder was still operational – you can hear Chepurny screaming before he died.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_Keyca: Access card to the living quarters
A universal key that opens almost all the doors in the X19 living quarters.
Access card to the experimental block
A key card used by scientists. Opens almost any door of the X19 level that studied special technology.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ03_Dunge: A steel key that looks like it's for a safe. Found in a Kurin basement.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ05_Freed: A PDA in a condition so bad that it's surprising it still works at all. The owner doesn't like letting go of either his old things, or the coupons needed to get replacements.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Contr: A remote control for some kind of device. There are so many buttons and switches that it's scary to touch, even when it's off. Definitely connected to developments in Project X. Found in Lukash's stash.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Gener: A key with a small tag that reads "Generator room".
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Fenri: A mercenary's PDA with cracks in the screen. The device survived a massive blast, unlike its owner.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_LostS: A very old notebook that belonged to one of the X19 researchers. Seems like something had quite the impact on this poor man's mental state.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_X19_Scient: Contains brief information on the death of the C-Consciousness scientists who didn't get the chance to make the world a better place.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ09_Mavka: The recorder still has the factory smell. It clearly hasn't been used much, or it may have just been stored for a special occasion.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Mercs: A folder with information gathered by Zen.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Radis: A PDA that belonged to a signal operator from the Perimeter Dam. The buttons have been replaced, and it has a sturdier frame than regular PDAs. The logo on the back says IPSF.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ04_Archi: A folder with documents on research into spatial anomalies. This is the information the mercenaries were looking for in the SIRCAA archives.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ02_Mavka: Page from a book with a note
A page from a book with a tea stain and a note in shaky handwriting.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Disci: Document found at the IPSF base
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_PDA_C: A PDA from the IPSF base
This PDA doesn't look like it's standard-issue, and it's covered in cartoon drawings made with a knife or other sharp object.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_PDA_B: This PDA is new, but looks like the owner spends all their time on it. All the buttons and the screen are covered in greasy fingerprints.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_OldNo: A folder with a letter written by an X19 employee that could never have been sent.
Document with a manual on portable tanks
A manual on sterilizing portable tanks. Seems like there was a problem with loading the last batch of tanks.
This PDA has a chat between MDST scientists, describing the difficulties they encountered trying to survive in the lab. Judging by the date, they lived here after the second disaster.
Contains a paper that indicates the MDST scientists didn't have access to the laboratory facilities. Seems like it had been sealed off earlier.
A worn folder with presentation notes
Documents with the results of controversial experiments that Project X scientists considered justified.
The PDA has Lukash's notes, describing the amazing capabilities of Project X, and what it means for Freedom.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ13_Kastr: Castro's beat-up PDA. The contents shed some light on why Castro didn't reply to Rubin's calls.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Zulus: A container packed with military explosives, taken from a bandit stash.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_NordG: Bears the logo of an unknown mercenary group, found on a body in the Testing Workshop. Mavka and Zulu will want to see this.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_G: A recording about a strange artifact
A recorder with Godot's note about an unusual find in a regular artifact batch.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_S: A sheet of paper with increasing amounts of debt listed on it. Found at a warehouse.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ11_B02_D: A regular key to a small space that Duty made into a storage room.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_Doctors_PD: One of the corners of the device is broken off, suggesting the PDA could have fallen and hit the floor. That could also be why some files on it have been damaged.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SlavenkoHu: A broken recorder. The experiment might have gone south.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ContractPD: The PDA only has one message left, labeled "Important".
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Brock: PDA that belonged to Bosch, one of Nord's mercenaries. The device glitches often, but you can still read one of the chats.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Drank: A PDA that belonged to one of Professor Taumin's assistants – looked after, and neatly kept in protective plastic. Contains the detailed reports and observations of a perfectionist researcher.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Chadi: A PDA with a cracked screen and covered in mud. Looks like the owner parted with it against his will – or in a hurry.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Taumi: Reddish-brown from blood, this PDA belonged to the head of a research expedition. Only one note remains, the rest of the data has been erased.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Corpu: PDA of a stalker in Corps uniform
This PDA seems to have suffered a fatal glitch in an anomaly. The text that never got the chance to be sent is still frozen on the screen.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Water: A scrap of paper covered in handwriting
Covered in small, sloppy handwriting, it seems this is one of many letters that never got their answer.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Freed: The device is slightly warm to the touch, as if someone were just holding it.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_Vydra: A lost PDA of an unknown stalker, found in a dusty old basement of the CNPP.
A rare type of PDA with notes from a dead stalker. Looks like he kept all his memories on this.
PDA of a stalker from the CNPP
The battery is held in with some duct tape, but it otherwise looks ordinary. The maps haven't been updated for quite some time. Listening to the recorded messages gives an unsettling feeling.
PDA of a stalker from the CNPP
The screen is surprisingly clean, and the frame doesn't have a single scratch on it. Someone left their most treasured thoughts here.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_c4_charge_: Explosive charge, most commonly used by the military. A reliable solution for missions that require destruction. You won't find many of these in the Zone, so use wisely.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Testi: Notes on the Testing Workshop experiments
These yellowish papers are from way back when the Workshop hosted a multitude of experiments, so it's a surprise they're still readable.
Status report on an unknown technology
Folder found in the Testing Workshop. A dark liquid has been spilled over it, you can only make out what's written on one of the papers.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_Rostok_Hub: PDA with a screen protector on the front. The device's owner clearly handled it with care.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Tache: An old army model that belonged to General Tachenko. No regulations or orders, just one damaged audio file. Seems like the Zone can break anyone.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_MercK: A little old key, clearly meant for a door.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_Quest: A rare type of PDA with notes from a dead stalker. Looks like he kept all his memories on this.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B01_V: A PDA with an order to place explosives in fresh snork hideouts under the checkpoint. The device is deformed, the screen broken.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_05: An old military-grade device that changed hands a lot in its years of service. The last one, judging by the contents of the PDA, was a great lover of pulp fiction.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_01: An old and yellowed sheet of paper with poorly preserved printed text.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ02_Garag: A torn page, where every letter is pressed into the paper.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_06: A brand-new PDA without a single scratch, but with dried blood on the buttons.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_02: A note with every letter carefully written. The author was clearly enjoying the moment, and was in no hurry.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_10: A folded A4 sheet of paper
Neatly handwritten note. A surprisingly accurate chaffinch is drawn in the corner.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_CNPP_: An old army PDA. Chipped paint, faded buttons, but still works.
On the back of the PDA, "Acorn" has been scratched with something sharp. You can see deep knife marks in place of one of the letters, as if the owner struggled with spelling.
PDA with a crushed screen. Judging by the shape of the dent, the owner punched their device.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Map_n: Map of CNPP with Monolith stashes
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Map_d: A worn hand-drawn map of the CNPP, schematic but precise. It marks several Monolith depots, one of them has a brief note next to it.
sid_questItemprototypes_QuestItem_KeyCar: This old green key card is a bit scratched, but the magnetic strip seems to be intact. It should probably still work.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_memo_1986_: A faded memo. It was crumpled up, then carefully smoothed out. Clearly, someone hesitated for a long time before deciding whether to hand it over.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_F: The back of the device has some kind of symbols scratched into it. You can't make out what they say.
The whole thing is covered in sticky stains. Bonespike probably uses it after surgeries and doesn't take his gloves off first.
A thin layer of dust on the front suggests the owner doesn't have much time to chat or look at funny pictures.
A colorful gum sticker on the back says a lot about the owner's cheerful personality.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_D: Judging by a deep shear on the front and a cracked screen, someone was so mad they threw it at the wall.
The device barely works. Just like its owner, it's definitely seen some action.
A PDA left at the CNPP's bar. It's in perfect condition – Zulu had just bought it after he lost the previous one.
Neat cursive indicates the author was born long before PDAs were a thing.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ01_GateK: Key card to the Iron Forest gate
Key card that opens the checkpoint gate to the Iron Forest. The smooth plastic is covered in scratches and has a half-faded IPSF logo.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Proje: On the slide, there's a photograph and a number. You need a slide projector to pull the image up onto a screen.

sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_N: A soaked note from the warehouse
A completely soaked sheet of paper. The ink is blurred, but the text is still readable.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_S: A special PDA – not for work purposes, but for contemplating on what can't be shared.
sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ElhantNote: Note from a stash in a tree
A piece of paper covered in fancy handwriting. The content is even more intriguing. Whoever wrote this must’ve been hit by the local psi-anomaly more than once.
sid_items_DLC01_GunTundra_DMR_descriptio: "That Captain Tachenko died a long time ago… and this General Tachenko of Duty will follow him… That's justice, I suppose…"
sid_items_DLC01_GunAKM9_ST_description: Small-batch AKM-74 variation for 9x39 caliber. This version is a cheap but effective alternative to a Lavina or a Vintar.
sid_items_DLC01_GunGP3Light_DMR_descript: A shorter assault version of the GP3, modified by a local armorer. Rifle rounds inside a lightweight carbine – a deadly combo.
sid_items_DLC01_GunSVUA_SR_description: SVU-MK, modified for extremely short-range combat. The word is that this rifle belonged to a seasoned Freedom fighter.
sid_items_DLC01_GunThreaded_SG_descripti: Modified to decrease dispersion, this SPSA-14 isn't suitable for shotgun ammunition, but it's perfect for slugs or darts. Good enough for an improvised sniper rifle.
sid_items_DLC01_GunKharodFWFreedom_ST_de: A custom-built rifle. The parts have been treated with an anti-corrosion coating and meticulously fitted. The receiver is covered in an unusual but masterfully painted ornament. It’s unlikely there is a second weapon like it in the Zone.
sid_items_DLC01_GunDniproFWDuty_ST_descr: Found at the site of a skirmish between an unknown Duty fighter and a pair of chimeras. Both beasts were slain, but the hero’s body could not be identified due to the severity of his wounds. The weapon has not had a new owner since.
